title: ptelea trifoliata var. pumila
intro: Ptelea trifoliata var. pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Prickly Ash, is a small shrub or tree with a compact growth habit, native to the eastern parts of North America. The health benefits of Dwarf Prickly Ash include its ability to relieve pain and inflammation, as well as its use in treating fever, coughs, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to promote the removal of mucus and reduce inflammation in the body. Bioactive constituents of Dwarf Prickly Ash include terpenoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
